test_name: Navigate to a Category Page and View Products
description: This scenario tests navigation to a specific product category and browsing the listed products.
steps: Locate the category link 'Women' in the header menu.
Verify the 'Women' category page loads with a list of products.
Scroll through the product list to view all available items.
Click on a product link (e.g., 'Blue Denim Shorts') to view its detailed page.
expected_results: The 'Women' category page should display all relevant products.
The product detail page for 'Blue Denim Shorts' should load correctly when clicked.
edge_cases: The category page does not load due to a network error.
The product list is incomplete or not displayed.
The category navigation link is broken.
The product detail page fails to load.
dependencies: The 'Women' category must exist in the catalog.
The category navigation links must be configured correctly.
The product catalog must be up-to-date.
performance_metrics: Page load time for the category page.
Scroll performance for the product list.
accessibility_requirements: Category links should be navigable via keyboard.
Screen readers should announce category names correctly.
Product links should have descriptive alt text.
